answer: The pulse counter is kept in inlet and crystal makes public each reset. An adversary therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 13 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 13 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 217 aliases cost 302 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
